title: launch --preset is an unknown argument: the old flag is not kept as an alias
source: intended: docs/decisions.md D6 and the no-alias row (the launch flag is --build)
intent: INTENDED behavior (defect N-10, build vocabulary; docs/decisions.md D6). `launch --preset <id> ...` is rejected like any flag the launcher does not know: exit 2, `JITSO REJECTED: unknown argument "--preset"` on stderr, nothing on stdout, nothing written, orca never called, even for an id that is in the catalog. The oracle still takes `--preset` as the build flag: the same dry run succeeds with exit 0 and prints the card, so the exit, the stdout and the stderr expectations FAIL on TS. The ts adapter maps `--build` to `--preset` and never the reverse, so `--preset` reaches the oracle unchanged.
